checks.name: lock_wait_metrics_summary
checks.expected: conflicting lock request is recorded as waiting with one wait-for edge
checks.actual: lock conflict observed through LockManager and wait graph

checks.name: full_isolation_matrix
checks.expected: RR keeps transaction snapshot stable while RC sees committed version after commit
checks.actual: focused RR/RC visibility matrix evaluated through TransactionManager.IsVisible

checks.name: long_transaction_runtime_metrics
checks.expected: active transaction count and transaction age are observable before and after commit
checks.actual: TransactionManager active map and transaction StartTime were sampled

checks.name: explicit_final_state_diff
checks.expected: concurrent transfer final state equals deterministic expected balances
checks.actual: in-process final-state map compared after concurrent operations complete

checks.name: wrapper_state_snapshot_diff
checks.expected: wrapper-style ordered snapshot equals expected concurrent write result
checks.actual: focused ordered snapshot diff completed after concurrent writes

checks.name: deadlock_victim_report
checks.expected: two-transaction wait cycle is detected and a victim transaction is identified
checks.actual: LockManager returned ErrDeadlockDetected for the second transaction forming the cycle

limitations: This is focused Go test-side consistency evidence.
It exercises lock conflicts, deadlock detection, MVCC visibility, deterministic final-state comparison, and snapshot comparison with in-process components.
It does not replace a full multi-client SQL workload or storage-engine Jepsen-style history checker.
